name: artist-caption-stage
description: Fan cam at a small live show — phone held up in the crowd, not professional photography

camera.type: iPhone held up in a crowd recording a concert
camera.angle: slightly below stage level, looking up at performer, not perfectly centered
camera.quality: iPhone video screenshot quality — compressed, noisy, not sharp. Digital noise in dark areas. Slight purple fringing on highlights.

environment.feel: cramped small venue, sweaty, dark, someone's phone screen glowing in the corner
environment.lighting: harsh stage spots from above — blown out orange and red highlights, deep black shadows, face half in darkness. Light spill is uneven and messy.
environment.backgrounds: out of focus crowd silhouettes, blurry stage equipment, maybe a phone screen or two glowing in the audience, exit sign in the distance
environment.avoid: even lighting, clean backgrounds, arena-sized venues, professional concert photography, perfectly exposed images, visible detail in dark areas

subject.expression: mid-performance — eyes closed singing, chin up, lost in the music
subject.pose: holding mic close, one hand up, or gripping mic stand, slightly blurry from movement
subject.clothing: dark — black hoodie, dark jacket, nothing bright or styled
subject.framing: not perfectly framed — subject slightly off center, maybe someone's head partially blocking the bottom, cropped awkwardly like a real phone photo

realism.priority: this MUST look like a screenshot from someone's iPhone concert video, not a professional photo or AI image
realism.texture: heavy digital noise in shadows, JPEG compression artifacts, slight color banding in gradients, skin has no retouching
realism.imperfections: lens flare bleeding across frame, blown out stage light spots that are pure white, someone's hand or phone slightly visible at edge of frame, chromatic aberration on bright lights, slight motion blur on performer's hands
realism.avoid: clean noise-free images, perfect skin, sharp focus on everything, symmetrical composition, studio quality, any sign of AI generation
